lambda_values.help: Optional comma-separated lambda sweep values, e.g. '50,100,200'.

p_set_mode.help: Competitor set mode: all wrong letters, parametric-only letter, or both (ablation).

evidence_aligned_mode.help: Evidence-aligned promotion mode: none, letter-only, extracted, or both (ablation).

evidence_top_n.help: Maximum number of extracted evidence-aligned tokens to promote.

evidence_expand_topn.help: Optional vocab-expansion count via anchor similarity (0 disables expansion).

evidence_gamma_ratio.help: Positive promotion scale gamma = evidence_gamma_ratio * lambda_prefill.

evidence_neg_bias_ratio.help: Optional explicit negative token bias scale on P-set, ratio * lambda_prefill.

eval_subset.help: Evaluate all rows or only baseline-wrong rows.

subset_from_results.help: Optional reference medqa_eval_results.jsonl path; when set, only baseline-wrong keys from this file are evaluated.

debug_wrong_examples.help: Print debug lines for first N baseline-wrong examples per lambda.

bootstrap_space.help: Defaults to the v3 headline bootstrap space.

tau_margin.help: Defaults to the v3 headline tau.

target_layers.help: Comma-separated layer indices. Empty means all layers.

position_modes.help: Comma-separated ITI position modes to validate.

c5_prompt_variant.help: Prompt wrapper used after inserting the explicit answer into the context.

tau.help: Gate threshold. Use 'auto' to select from oracle_P baseline on this frozen pilot.

run_main.help: auto stops before intervention when premise agreement is below premise_go_threshold.

include_ids_path.help: Optional JSON/JSONL/text file of example IDs to evaluate. When set, examples are selected by id and ordered by this file; max_items limits this ordered list.

premise_path.help: Premise-check v2 per_item.jsonl. Use 'auto' to resolve known locations.

ov_results_path.help: CounterFact OV-steering per-item JSONL. Use 'auto' for the prior L27/H20 gate-stats path; pass an explicit path if the file is stored elsewhere.

old_path.help: Legacy Appendix E per-pair disruption results.jsonl.

batch_size.help: Progress chunk size; decoding remains deterministic.
